inventory_metadata.title: Pelagos Vessel Fuel Consumption Intelligence Input Inventory & Data Feasibility Specification
inventory_metadata.governance_standard: Naval Architecture Hydrodynamic Modeling and Statutory Class Registry Integrity Standard
evidence_governance_principles: Distinguish directly inspected statutory registers (ClassNK, DNV) from secondary source-reported builder delivery particulars.
Shipyard benchmark power is explicitly Continuous Service Rating engine brake power (P_B,CSR), NOT delivered shaft power (P_S) or trial measured power (P_trial).

Calculated propulsion power represents estimated required engine brake power at the flywheel coupling. Both numerator and denominator in engine-load calculation use compatible brake-power definitions.

All candidate vessel CSR values correspond to approximately 85% of MCR (IRIS BLISS: 8210/9660 ≈ 84.990%, NAVIOS VICTORY: 7080/8330 ≈ 84.994%, BERGE GALDHOPIGGEN: 5185/6100 = 85.000%). Because statutory registers do not index CSR, whether these are independent trial benchmarks or nominal 85% MCR derivations is unverified. The relationship is strictly classified as UNVERIFIED_SECONDARY_RELATIONSHIP.
Single-point Admiralty calibration is a first-order research tool, NOT an independent validation of the full speed-power curve.
The model strictly evaluates continuous rated-power capacity (<= 100% MCR) and fails closed when the continuous rated boundary is exceeded.
Ballast hydrostatics are unindexed in public registers and fail closed to UNAVAILABLE without arbitrary percentage assumptions.

admiralty_coefficient_method.applicable_vessel_types: Displacement hulls (Bulk carriers, tankers) operating in the sub-critical Froude regime (Fn <= 0.18, approx 10-15 knots).
input_requirements: Displacement Delta (metric tonnes) for specified loading condition (laden or ballast). NEVER substitute DWT.
Calibrated design Admiralty coefficient C_adm established from certified sea-trial or yard delivery design points.
admiralty_coefficient_method.feasibility_in_pelagos: FEASIBLE_WITH_CERTIFIED_BENCHMARKS. Supported for vessels with authentic yard delivery specifications (Oshima, Koyo, DNV) in research mode. Fails closed to UNAVAILABLE if displacement or certified design speed is absent.
admiralty_coefficient_method.known_assumptions_and_uncertainty: Assumes geometric and dynamic similarity across normal service speed range; valid within +/- 15-20% of design speed. Single-point calibration assumes constant C_adm and represents a first-order research approximation, NOT an independent validation of the full speed-power curve. Shipyard benchmark power represents Continuous Service Rating engine brake power (P_B,CSR), NOT delivered shaft power (P_S) or trial measured power (P_trial). The contractual 15% sea margin is an UNVERIFIED_SECONDARY_RELATIONSHIP. Ballast hydrostatics are unindexed in public registers and fail closed to UNAVAILABLE.

holtrop_mennen_resistance_method.formula: R_total = R_f*(1+k1) + R_app + R_w + R_b + R_tr + R_a
holtrop_mennen_resistance_method.applicable_vessel_types: General displacement and semi-displacement merchant hulls.
input_requirements: Waterline length (Lwl), beam (B), draft (T), displacement volume (Nabla).
Block coefficient (Cb), prismatic coefficient (Cp), midship coefficient (Cm), waterplane area coefficient (Cwp).
Longitudinal center of buoyancy (LCB), forward bulbous bow cross-sectional area (A_BT), bulb center height (h_b).
Immersed transom stern area (A_t), stem entrance angle (i_e), wetted surface area (S).
holtrop_mennen_resistance_method.feasibility_in_pelagos: INFEASIBLE_WITHOUT_SYNTHETIC_DATA. Public statutory classification society registers (ClassNK, DNV, LR, BV) DO NOT report bulbous bow geometry, transom area, waterplane coefficient, or lines plans. Running Holtrop-Mennen would require fabricating 10+ proprietary hull parameters. Prohibited under Pelagos non-synthetic data governance.
holtrop_mennen_resistance_method.known_assumptions_and_uncertainty: Requires full lines plan and model basin calibration; high sensitivity to estimated bulb and transom parameters.

vessel_particulars.source: Shipyard Technical Delivery Sheet (LDT) combined with ClassNK/DNV Summer Scantling Deadweight (DWT). Directly inspected class registers publish DWT and draft, but not LDT.
vessel_particulars.missing_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED_UNAVAILABLE (DWT is never substituted for displacement)

vessel_particulars.source: Unpublished in statutory registers; fails closed without verified sea-trial record
vessel_particulars.missing_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED_UNAVAILABLE (when condition=ballast; arbitrary percentage scaling and silent fallback to laden coefficients strictly prohibited)

vessel_particulars.source: Shipyard Specification / Class Society Design Point
vessel_particulars.missing_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED_UNAVAILABLE (Admiralty coefficient cannot be calibrated without design speed)

machinery_particulars.source: Shipyard Technical Delivery Specification (Continuous Service Rating engine brake power P_B,CSR). Secondary relationship to MCR (CSR ~ 85% MCR) is classified as UNVERIFIED_SECONDARY_RELATIONSHIP.

operating_conditions.unit: percentage (e.g. 0.0 for calm water, 10.0-15.0 for standard research scenario)
operating_conditions.source: User-configured research sensitivity parameter. NOT a dynamic NOAA/Copernicus meteo-oceanographic correction. Preserves physical distinction: Speed Through Water (STW) differs from Speed Over Ground (SOG).
